options.title: Har state ka official pakshi kaunsa hai? 🐦
options.first_line: हर स्टेट का ऑफिशियल पक्षी कौन-सा है? अपना स्टेट ढूँढिए।
options.first_frame: All of India on the relief map, every state still pale paper, a small bird sticker hovering over the middle of the country

options.title: Kerala aur Arunachal ka pakshi ek kyun? 🐦 Har state ka pakshi
options.first_line: केरल और अरुणाचल, भारत के दो सिरे, फिर भी पक्षी एक क्यों?
options.first_frame: Kerala at the bottom and Arunachal Pradesh at the top-right already lit the same green, a dotted line pulsing between them across a pale India

options.title: Teen states ka ek hi pakshi? 🐦 Apne state ka pakshi pehchaniye
options.first_line: कौन-सा पक्षी तीन स्टेट्स ने एक साथ चुना? अपना स्टेट देखिए।
options.first_frame: Karnataka, Telangana and Odisha glowing the same blue on a pale India, a question-mark tag over each

why: Two named ends of India lit the same green poses a real how-is-that-possible puzzle the viewer must stay to resolve, and the first frame shows it without sound, while A has no mystery and C only asks which bird.
note: B's title and first line use Keralam / केरलम (writer, 27 Nov): the state's official name since 25 Aug 2026 (checklist); the map draws केरलम.
